includes: authoritative attempt record-state and persistent locks (#254)
mandatory completion compaction and operation obligations (#259)
scope: A reproducible source baseline for the current pre-1.0 record format. Issue #259 requires compaction obligations and automatic completion compaction, without legacy-format fallback. This source baseline keeps every compatibility journey active for the new format. It is not a released artifact or the future v1.0.0 stable baseline.
release_requirement: After the first successful stable publication, set stable.original and stable.latest to its complete pinned release references. After each later stable publication, retain original and update latest through a PR before preparing another candidate. Until then, stable=null selects the provisional pinned source comparison.
